# Envoy > DSH 子包注册 Envoy Skill、MCP 和链接读取提示，输出可定位资料。 ## 研究范围 - **仓库**：[regrevia/Envoy](https://github.com/regrevia/Envoy) - **版本号**：0.1.44（[固定提交 c639ca55eb226f7c4dd5c2af48c167a1fcafe3f3](https://github.com/regrevia/Envoy/tree/c639ca55eb226f7c4dd5c2af48c167a1fcafe3f3)） - **版本日期**：2026-11-04（固定提交日期，北京时间；不是包发布日期） ## 结论状态 静态核对适配、路由和启动；未运行链接读取。 ## 洞察短评 - **用途**：用户把文章、PDF、音视频链接交给 DSH 整理。 - **亮点**：[Q01](#research-q01) 给公开链接加读取路由和可引用材料路径。 - **思考**：[Q02](#research-q02) 需外部 runtime，探索基准不足以证明事实正确。 - **建议**：[Q03](#research-q03) 相同时限比较材料覆盖和事实错误。 采用建议：[Q03](#research-q03) 固定链接同预算人工对照。 ## 核心贡献 [Q01](#research-q01) 给公开链接加读取路由和可引用材料路径。 ## 关键质疑 [Q02](#research-q02) 需外部 runtime，探索基准不足以证明事实正确。 ## 重点创新推演与最小验证 [Q03](#research-q03) 相同时限比较材料覆盖和事实错误。 相同时限核对文章、PDF 和视频材料与引用。 ## 场景与替代办法 用户把文章、PDF、音视频链接交给 DSH 整理。 原生读取或人工选择工具并整理材料。 ## 依赖与流程 | 依赖或条件 | 是否必需 | 用途 | 缺失或不满足时 | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | Envoy runtime 和兼容 DSH | 必需 | 提供读取 MCP | 版本不符拒绝或 provision | | 浏览器、ASR 和站点权限 | 按材料需要 | 渲染和转写 | 登录墙需人工 | | 步骤 | 执行者与动作 | 成功判据或失败处理 | | --- | --- | --- | | 准备 | 确认 runtime | 固定有权限材料 | | 读取 | 交链接并检查工具 | 核对返回来源 | | 写作 | 使用保留材料和定位 | 缺口单独补查 | ## 成本与效果 | 阶段 | 现金与资源成本 | 人工与时间投入 | 已知条件与未知项 | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | 首次 | 下载成本未知 | 配置 runtime 和模型 | 按功能差异 | | 持续 | 资源未知 | 核对素材和站点变化 | 缓存需维护 | | 失败 | 人工时间未知 | 按缺口取材 | 登录或验证码单独处理 | | 效果项 | 当前证据支持 | 尚不能确定 | | --- | --- | --- | | 资料读取 | 带来源定位的材料 | 覆盖、正确性和节时 | ## 研究问题与完整回答 **插件研究总目标**：DSH 用户能否从公开链接取得可核对的资料并减少手工选工具？ ### Q01 · DSH 子包如何改变公开链接的读取流程？ **研究主题**：场景与需求、功能与机制、贡献与相对优势 #### 完整回答 子包挂 Envoy MCP 并注册适配 Skill，在符合条件的首个 step 前插入一条路由提示。它先取得下游决策，判断 enter、当前消息、退出标记及可用公开 URL 后才加消息。相对用户手工选择读取工具，提示引导模型用保留材料与定位信息，但不是强制执行保证。 #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 源码核查**：[integrations/dsh/envoy-dsh/README.md:3-14](https://github.com/regrevia/Envoy/blob/c639ca55eb226f7c4dd5c2af48c167a1fcafe3f3/integrations/dsh/envoy-dsh/README.md#L3-L14) 子包三项职责。
查看原文（12行） ```text This package is a DeepSeek Harness bundle for [Envoy](../../../README.md). It does three things in one install: 1. mounts Envoy's stdio MCP bridge with `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client`; 2. registers an adapted Envoy Agent Skill on the public `ctx.skills` service; 3. listens to the `agent/pre-step` event and, on the first step of a turn whose user message contains a public link, prepends one short routing message. The adaptation keeps Envoy's reading, discovery, expansion, visual handoff, and capability behavior. It changes only the integration surface: the skill uses the `mcp__envoy__*` tool names that DeepSeek Harness assigns to the mounted server. ```
**依据 2 · 源码核查**：[integrations/dsh/envoy-dsh/index.js:640-675](https://github.com/regrevia/Envoy/blob/c639ca55eb226f7c4dd5c2af48c167a1fcafe3f3/integrations/dsh/envoy-dsh/index.js#L640-L675) 下游决策与提示接线。
查看原文（36行） ```text if (decision === null || typeof decision !== 'object') return decision if (decision.kind !== 'enter') return decision if (!Array.isArray(decision.messages) || decision.messages.length === 0) { return decision } if (!shouldInjectLinkRouting(payload)) return decision const messages = payload.messages if (messages.some(isRoutingMessage)) return decision if (decision.messages.some(isRoutingMessage)) return decision const text = messages.map(messageText).join('\n') if (isOptedOut(text)) return decision const urls = routableUrls(text) if (urls.length === 0) return decision const routingMessage = createRoutingUserMessage(urls, { language: detectRoutingLanguage(text), }) return { ...decision, messages: [routingMessage, ...decision.messages] } } /** * Register the Envoy skill provider synchronously, as `ctx.skills` requires, * and install the link-routing waterfall listener. * @param {import('cordis').Context} ctx */ export function apply(ctx) { ctx.skills.registerProvider(() => provider) if (typeof ctx.on !== 'function') return ctx.on('agent/pre-step', async (payload, next) => { const decision = await next() try { return injectLinkRouting(decision, payload) } catch (error) { // A routing notice must never break a turn: degrade to the untouched // decision, which is what the default handler produced. ctx.logger?.warn?.('envoy-dsh: link routing skipped', error) return decision ```
**依据 3 · 源码核查**：[integrations/dsh/envoy-dsh/README.md:18-36](https://github.com/regrevia/Envoy/blob/c639ca55eb226f7c4dd5c2af48c167a1fcafe3f3/integrations/dsh/envoy-dsh/README.md#L18-L36) 作者材料与探索对照。
查看原文（19行） ```text ## One link in, AI-ready material out Whatever you are looking at, hand it over and get the thing you wanted out: Markdown, a wiki page, a knowledge-base entry. Douyin, Bilibili, Xiaohongshu, Zhihu, WeChat posts, articles, PDFs and podcasts all take the same path. A read returns a source-linked transcript with timestamps, frames, and a `material_id` you can quote, so the agent writes from what was actually said, not from the title. For a whole feed, `envoy collect` checkpoints every item, so an interrupted run resumes instead of restarting. Measured on 123 live links across those platforms: **80% usable as source material** — that is 93% of the links that answered at all — with **0 failures** and every gap named. Same 60 turns per arm, with and without the bundle: **ends normally without saying it could not read 22% → 92%**, **times out 68% → 0**, **answer hits at least one reference-fact keyword 23% → 82%**. That A/B is exploratory (different caps, no human correctness review); the per-read behaviour is what the tests assert. ```
#### 缺口 - 没有独立读取或正确性测试 **影响**：无法证明材料覆盖与模型服从提示 **进一步探讨**：同一链接比对实际素材、缺口和引用 ### Q02 · 后端与基准有什么采用限制？ **研究主题**：工程质量与复用、缺陷与关键质疑、依赖、兼容与流程 #### 完整回答 launch 解析外部或私有 runtime，外部版本不足会拒绝，私有缺失则尝试 provision，再以 stdio 启 MCP。依赖浏览器、ASR、网络及站点登录条件。作者 A/B 时间上限不同且无人工正确性复核，不能用完成比例证明答案质量。 #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 源码核查**：[integrations/dsh/envoy-dsh/launch.cjs:227-246](https://github.com/regrevia/Envoy/blob/c639ca55eb226f7c4dd5c2af48c167a1fcafe3f3/integrations/dsh/envoy-dsh/launch.cjs#L227-L246) 版本和自动 provision。
查看原文（20行） ```text if (binary) { const have = versionOf(binary) if (have && atLeast(have, REQUIRED)) return binary if (external) { fail( binary + ' is Envoy ' + (have || 'unknown') + ', this DSH bundle needs >=' + REQUIRED + '; upgrade that install (uv tool upgrade envoy-cli, or brew/uv accordingly) or unset ' + 'ENVOY_BIN / PATH envoy so the bundle provisions its own runtime', ) } process.stderr.write( 'envoy-dsh: upgrading the bundled runtime from ' + (have || 'unknown') + ' to ' + VERSION + '; the Envoy settings and downloaded models are kept\n', ) } provision() if (!existsSync(RUNTIME_BIN)) fail('runtime install finished without ' + RUNTIME_BIN) if (!versionOf(RUNTIME_BIN)) fail('cannot run ' + RUNTIME_BIN + ' --version after install') return RUNTIME_BIN ```
**依据 2 · 源码核查**：[integrations/dsh/envoy-dsh/launch.cjs:249-270](https://github.com/regrevia/Envoy/blob/c639ca55eb226f7c4dd5c2af48c167a1fcafe3f3/integrations/dsh/envoy-dsh/launch.cjs#L249-L270) MCP 子进程。
查看原文（22行） ```text const binary = resolveRuntime() // Hand the process over to `envoy mcp`. The MCP client talks to this process // over stdio, so the child's stdio is wired straight to this process's own // handles rather than 'inherit': under a cmd.exe hop the inherited console // handles are not the pipes the MCP client reads, and the handshake goes // silent. Passing process.stdin/stdout/stderr keeps the same descriptors. const env = Object.assign({}, process.env) env.PATH = env.PATH ? BIN_DIR + delimiter + env.PATH : BIN_DIR if (IS_WINDOWS && !env.PATHEXT) env.PATHEXT = '.COM;.EXE;.BAT;.CMD' // A .cmd shim (what `install.ps1` puts on PATH) needs cmd.exe to start. const [command, commandArgs] = shellInvocation(binary, ['mcp']) const child = spawn(command, commandArgs, { stdio: [process.stdin, process.stdout, process.stderr], env, }) child.on('error', (error) => fail('cannot start ' + binary + ': ' + error.message)) child.on('exit', (code, signal) => { if (signal) process.kill(process.pid, signal) process.exit(code === null ? 1 : code) }) ```
**依据 3 · 源码核查**：[integrations/dsh/envoy-dsh/README.md:58-70](https://github.com/regrevia/Envoy/blob/c639ca55eb226f7c4dd5c2af48c167a1fcafe3f3/integrations/dsh/envoy-dsh/README.md#L58-L70) 作者对比限制。
查看原文（13行） ```text The turn-level A/B we ran is exploratory, not a claim: the two arms had different time limits (900 s and 2400 s) and one arm was graded terminal-only. Article-level citation counts came out level within noise over 60 turns per arm. What this bundle guarantees is the per-read behaviour above, and the tests assert it. ## What stays the same without the bundle Reading a link without Envoy still works. What the bundle adds is not a new capability the model lacks, but a bounded one: declared visual input, a retained material you can search instead of re-fetching, an explicit gap when a source cannot be read, and a human step instead of an executable command when the page needs one. ```
#### 缺口 - 实际站点、登录和依赖下载未测 **影响**：首次安装体积及材料质量未知 **进一步探讨**：逐站点验证登录墙、失败状态和素材来源 ### Q03 · 怎样判断对资料整理有帮助？ **研究主题**：采用判断、效果与总成本、新假设与验证 #### 完整回答 固定少量文章、PDF 和公开视频，在隔离环境对照原生读取与此 bundle，按同一时限人工标注正文覆盖、时间定位和事实错误。先预装或确认 runtime 与可选模型，只使用本人有权访问的材料。若无法核对保留材料或结果只剩标题，就回到人工取材。 #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 源码核查**：[integrations/dsh/envoy-dsh/README.md:49-60](https://github.com/regrevia/Envoy/blob/c639ca55eb226f7c4dd5c2af48c167a1fcafe3f3/integrations/dsh/envoy-dsh/README.md#L49-L60) 材料类型及对照限制。
查看原文（12行） ```text | Ask | Harness on its own | With this bundle | | --- | --- | --- | | Long article, WeChat post, Zhihu column | Truncated text, or only the digest | Body text with headings and source locators | | PDF | First pages, or a screenshot of the page | Per-page text with page numbers and locators | | Video (Douyin, Bilibili) | Title, cover, description, danmaku | Bound player file; captions or ASR with a coverage figure; frames when the host declares it can show them | | Audio | Nothing usable | Timestamped transcript; low confidence and no-speech are stated, not hidden | | Login wall | 403, empty body, or a captcha page | `challenge_required` plus the human step: import cookies for one site scope, or sign in once | | Unreadable page | A plausible guess | `partial` with the part that was read, and the gap named | The turn-level A/B we ran is exploratory, not a claim: the two arms had different time limits (900 s and 2400 s) and one arm was graded terminal-only. Article-level citation counts came out level within noise over 60 turns per arm. ```
**依据 2 · 源码核查**：[integrations/dsh/envoy-dsh/launch.cjs:227-246](https://github.com/regrevia/Envoy/blob/c639ca55eb226f7c4dd5c2af48c167a1fcafe3f3/integrations/dsh/envoy-dsh/launch.cjs#L227-L246) 版本前置成本。
查看原文（20行） ```text if (binary) { const have = versionOf(binary) if (have && atLeast(have, REQUIRED)) return binary if (external) { fail( binary + ' is Envoy ' + (have || 'unknown') + ', this DSH bundle needs >=' + REQUIRED + '; upgrade that install (uv tool upgrade envoy-cli, or brew/uv accordingly) or unset ' + 'ENVOY_BIN / PATH envoy so the bundle provisions its own runtime', ) } process.stderr.write( 'envoy-dsh: upgrading the bundled runtime from ' + (have || 'unknown') + ' to ' + VERSION + '; the Envoy settings and downloaded models are kept\n', ) } provision() if (!existsSync(RUNTIME_BIN)) fail('runtime install finished without ' + RUNTIME_BIN) if (!versionOf(RUNTIME_BIN)) fail('cannot run ' + RUNTIME_BIN + ' --version after install') return RUNTIME_BIN ```
#### 缺口 - 人工正确性和任务收益未知 **影响**：不能推算文章产出效率 **进一步探讨**：同一时限盲评并记录失败与人工步骤 ## 工程统计 统计范围：git tracked files at exact commit; component scope only；组件：integrations/dsh/envoy-dsh；内容摘要：c8fae0349528f5f840bea33da07e5f9bbe972d70f8315d98db3892bafbf0f697。sloc 0.3.2，TypeScript 5.9.3。 仅统计 Markdown 和指定的 JavaScript／TypeScript 扩展名；Python 等其他语言不纳入，表格不代表全语言代码规模。 | 扩展名 | 范围 | 文件数 | 总行 | 代码行 | 注释行 | 字数 | |---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:| | .js | source | 1 | 678 | 443 | 196 | — | | .js | test | 1 | 166 | 149 | 59 | — | | .cjs | source | 1 | 270 | 208 | 42 | — | | .md | source | 3 | 1264 | — | — | 10823 | 排除 0 项，解析错误 0 项；默认排除规则是启发式，源文件与打包产物可能重复，不能从行数推算原创量或工时。Markdown 字数与代码行分别计量，未知不填0。 ## 能力清单 | 能力 | 主要用途 | 使用条件与边界 | | --- | --- | --- | | 链接路由 | 提示选读取工具 | 模型仍决定调用 | | 读取后端 | 返回可定位素材 | 依赖外部 Envoy | ## 工程亮点 [Q02](#research-q02) Launcher 可 provision，版本和站点能力都需核对。 ## 验证与边界 - 已检查：作者 README、包清单、源码路径 integrations/dsh/envoy-dsh/README.md、integrations/dsh/envoy-dsh/index.js、integrations/dsh/envoy-dsh/launch.cjs 及固定范围 inventory；组件：integrations/dsh/envoy-dsh。抽读不冒充完整审计，来源和原文嵌入正式快照时保留。 - 未执行：插件安装、目标代码与测试、真实宿主及模型任务。源码存在不等于运行通过。 - 边界：仅固定 DSH 子包，根引擎能力作为作者主张，未运行。 - 下一步：相同时限核对文章、PDF 和视频材料与引用。

"integrations/dsh/envoy-dsh/README.md", "content": "# Envoy for DeepSeek Harness This package is a DeepSeek Harness bundle for [Envoy](../../../README.md). It does three things in one install: 1. mounts Envoy's stdio MCP bridge with `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client`; 2. registers an adapted Envoy Agent Skill on the public `ctx.skills` service; 3. listens to the `agent/pre-step` event and, on the first step of a turn whose user message contains a public link, prepends one short routing message. The adaptation keeps Envoy's reading, discovery, expansion, visual handoff, and capability behavior. It changes only the integration surface: the skill uses the `mcp__envoy__*` tool names that DeepSeek Harness assigns to the mounted server. [中文快速安装](../README.md) · [Envoy 安装指南](../../skills/envoy/INSTALL.md) ## One link in, AI-ready material out Whatever you are looking at, hand it over and get the thing you wanted out: Markdown, a wiki page, a knowledge-base entry. Douyin, Bilibili, Xiaohongshu, Zhihu, WeChat posts, articles, PDFs and podcasts all take the same path. A read returns a source-linked transcript with timestamps, frames, and a `material_id` you can quote, so the agent writes from what was actually said, not from the title. For a whole feed, `envoy collect` checkpoints every item, so an interrupted run resumes instead of restarting. Measured on 123 live links across those platforms: **80% usable as source material** — that is 93% of the links that answered at all — with **0 failures** and every gap named. Same 60 turns per arm, with and without the bundle: **ends normally without saying it could not read 22% → 92%**, **times out 68% → 0**, **answer hits at least one reference-fact keyword 23% → 82%**. That A/B is exploratory (different caps, no human correctness review); the per-read behaviour is what the tests assert. The harness is in `docs/experiments/link-compatibility.md`; rerun it with `scripts/acceptance/link_coverage.py`. The same Envoy skill ships for Codex and Claude Code; this package is the DeepSeek Harness build, and the deliverables are the same Markdown, wiki, or knowledge-base material on all three hosts. ## What changes when it is installed Same model, same links. The difference is what a read puts in front of the agent. | Ask | Harness on its own | With this bundle | | --- | --- | --- | | Long article, WeChat post, Zhihu column | Truncated text, or only the digest | Body text with headings and source locators | | PDF | First pages, or a screenshot of the page | Per-page text with page numbers and locators | | Video (Douyin, Bilibili) | Title, cover, description, danmaku | Bound player file; captions or ASR with a coverage figure; frames when the host declares it can show them | | Audio | Nothing usable | Timestamped transcript; low confidence and no-speech are stated, not hidden | | Login wall | 403, empty body, or a captcha page | `challenge_required` plus the human step: import cookies for one site scope, or sign in once | | Unreadable page | A plausible guess | `partial` with the part that was read, and the gap named | The turn-level A/B we ran is exploratory, not a claim: the two arms had different time limits (900 s and 2400 s) and one arm was graded terminal-only. Article-level citation counts came out level within noise over 60 turns per arm. What this bundle guarantees is the per-read behaviour above, and the tests assert it. ## What stays the same without the bundle Reading a link without Envoy still works. What the bundle adds is not a new capability the model lacks, but a bounded one: declared visual input, a retained material you can search instead of re-fetching, an explicit gap when a source cannot be read, and a human step instead of an executable command when the page needs one. ## Requirements - DeepSeek Harness with the Plugin Manager (`engines.dsh` is `>=0.1.5`). - macOS, Linux, or Windows.
